integrity: Two self-contained finite enumerators using different gradient-acyclicity checks reproduce six nonidentity traces, matched orbit counts and a separate published tetrahedral small case; exact integers are used.
scientific_limitations: The result is the full reduced rational alternating homology character only, not the uncomputed graded homology of the four-simplex Morse-matching complex. The identity trace uses the exact face vector from Scoville (2026); nonidentity traces are newly exhaustively computed. An unindexed equivalent calculation is possible; independent expert validation has not been performed.
title: The full equivariant Euler character of the four-simplex Morse-matching complex
